systems.system: SIGE (Système d'information pour la gestion de l'éducation)
systems.owner: MENPC (Ministère de l'Éducation nationale et de la Promotion civique)
systems.tiers: all levels except higher education, including technical and vocational; annual yearbooks, with no yearbook for 2017/2018 and 2018/2019 because no school survey was run

note: SIGE is described only as in place since 2014 and producing annual statistical yearbooks from a school survey; no entry by schools between survey days is stated, so it is census class and gives no emis fact.
